top_signals.title: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent crude oil hits highest level since March
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 as stocks fell and Brent crude hit its highest level since March, leaving the 50-day moving average in focus.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iran Plots, Houthi Attacks Spur US Departure Orders in Mideast
top_signals.summary: The US has ordered the departure of diplomatic personnel and adjusted staffing at embassies across the Middle East as a result of Iranian efforts to target Americans, as well as threats from Houthi militants in Yemen, according to an American official.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: TikTok U.S. hunts for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity, sources tell CNBC

top_signals.title: Singapore Expands Haze Investigation to 10 Locally Based Firms
top_signals.summary: Singapore expanded its investigation into haze-creating fires in Indonesia that have blanketed the city-state in smog, requesting information from 10 locally registered companies.

top_signals.title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
top_signals.summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.
